name: unity
title: Unity (C#)
applies: A Unity project in the root of the repository (Assets/, Packages/ and ProjectSettings/ at the top), saved with the Unity version of the Maestro image.

rules.rule: Every asset under Assets/ has its .meta file, no .meta file is left without its asset, and no two assets share a GUID.
Scenes, prefabs and other assets are saved as text (Force Text), with visible meta files, so a change to them can be read and reviewed.
The project is saved with the Unity version that checks it, so opening it never upgrades it.
Every script compiles in Unity without errors.
enforced_by: the Unity Editor in batch mode
conventions/unity/compile.sh, the quick check without a licence

rules.rule: All EditMode and PlayMode tests pass, and the project has at least one test.
The agent does not add, remove or change packages; the owner does.
enforced_by: the diff policy of the Maestro service (Packages/manifest.json is protected)
the secret scan of the Maestro service

rules.rule: The agent cannot change these rules, the scripts that check them, or the CI workflows.
enforced_by: the diff policy of the Maestro service (protected paths)

image:
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends xvfb xauth libgtk-3-0 libgl1 libglu1-mesa libgbm1 libvulkan1 libasound2 libnss3 libxtst6 libxss1 libcap2 libicu72 libssl3 \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
 && printf '6d61657374726f2d756e697479303031\n' > /etc/machine-id
image_note: the Unity Editor 6000.3.29f1 for Linux (about 8 GB)
after_apply: In Unity, set Edit > Project Settings > Editor > Asset Serialization to Force Text and Version Control to Visible Meta Files, if they are not already.
Run `maestro unity activate` on every machine that runs agents for the project. The licence stays on that machine and is given to the checks only, never to the agent.
For CI, add the repository secret UNITY_LICENSE (see the comment at the top of .github/workflows/conventions-unity.yml).
